class.name: OpenXRAndroidGoogleCloudAuthExtension
class.description: Wraps the [code]XR_ANDROID_google_cloud_auth[/code] extension, which provides authentication for Google Cloud services used by other Android XR extensions such as [OpenXRAndroidGeospatialExtension].

method.name: is_authenticated
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if any of the authentication methods have been successfully completed. See [method set_google_cloud_auth_api_key], [method set_google_cloud_auth_keyless], and [method set_google_cloud_auth_token].

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the [code]XR_ANDROID_google_cloud_auth[/code] extension is supported by the OpenXR runtime.

method.name: set_google_cloud_auth_api_key
method.description: Sets Google Cloud authentication using an API key. Returns an [OpenXRFutureResult] that completes when authentication is finished.

method.name: set_google_cloud_auth_keyless
method.description: Sets Google Cloud authentication using keyless authentication. Returns an [OpenXRFutureResult] that completes when authentication is finished.

method.name: set_google_cloud_auth_token
method.description: Sets Google Cloud authentication using an auth token. Returns an [OpenXRFutureResult] that completes when authentication is finished.
